verdict.rationale: Gitea supplies building blocks for governance: GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD, Pull Request/AGit code review, user permission management and access control lists, an admin configuration panel, and an API and webhooks for custom workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows enforcing standards or CI/CD policies centrally across all teams and repositories, so a devops-lead would likely need to assemble this from per-repo setup and custom tooling. Missing for 10: branch protection or required status checks, org- or instance-wide required workflows or policy templates, enforcement of required reviews or merge rules across repos, any independent corroboration of cross-team policy enforcement.
